（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
Date 23/5/16 A.M.
No 340
Shanghai Municipal Council.
May 22nd 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that at 11.40 a.m. on 21st a Chinese named Pih Jing 畢景 was arrested at the Railway Station. On being searched by the Chinese Police two letters containing revolutionary correspondence were found on his person. He was taken to Paoshan Police Station and at 3 p.m. was sent to the Chapel Central Station. Nothing further unusual was reported during the day.
— It is reported that Chu Tsung 朱正 will be elected to fill the position rendered vacant through the death of Chen Chi Lie 陳其美. The body of the latter has been coffined but has not yet been removed from No.11 Sing Ming Li. That address has been visited during the past few days by Messrs Li Ping Shu 李平書 Li Ying Zah 李英石 Sung Li Fong 宋禮芳 Wong Foo 黃印 Chen Chi Zou 陳其才 brother of deceased and Sun Yat Sen 孫逸仙.
It is said that the first two named of these are trying to make arrangements with Fong Kou Chang to have Chen Chi Mei interred in the same place as Song Kyau Zung.
It is reported that the rebels are now using No.17 Rue Paul Beau as a meeting place.
Sun Yat Sen has removed to No.317 Avenue Joffre where he is staying with a Japanese named Kurai.
Three of the four men who entered the room in which Chen Che May was assassinated have been accounted for. The actual assassin was shot dead by some of the members of Chen Chi May's party and two of his accomplices were wounded and are now in the hospital of St. Marie on the Route Pere Robert.

Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

编号
（印章：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科。）
日期 16年5月23日 上午
第 340 号
致上海工部局。
1916年5月22日。

先生：
据报，21日上午11时40分，一名名为畢景（Pih Jing）的华人在火车站被捕。经华人巡捕搜查，在其身上发现两封含有革命通信内容的信件。他被带至宝山巡捕房，并于下午3时被送往中央捕房教堂分部。当日未报告其他异常情况。
— 据报，朱正（Chu Tsung）将当选以填补因陳其美（Chen Chi Lie）去世而空缺的职位。后者的遗体已入殓，但尚未从新明里11号移出。在过去几天中，李平書（Li Ping Shu）、李英石（Li Ying Zah）、宋禮芳（Sung Li Fong）、黃印（Wong Foo）、死者之弟陳其才（Chen Chi Zou）以及孫逸仙（Sun Yat Sen）曾造访该地址。
据悉，上述前两人正试图与冯国璋（Fong Kou Chang）安排，将陳其美安葬于与宋教仁（Song Kyau Zung）同一地点。
据报，反叛分子目前正使用博伟路（Rue Paul Beau）17号作为集会场所。
孫逸仙已搬至霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）317号，与一名名为Kurai的日本人同住。
进入陳其美（Chen Che May）遇刺房间的四名男子中，已有三人下落查明。实际行凶者被陳其美（Chen Chi May）党派中的几名成员开枪击毙，其两名同伙受伤，现住在罗伯特神父路（Route Pere Robert）的圣玛丽医院。

您顺从的仆人，
总探长。

警务处总监上尉
